verdict.rationale: Convertio is a cloud file converter, so chaining convert-then-optimize-then-deliver into one job or watched workflow is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents single conversions (drag-and-drop UI, API, CLI, OCR, per-conversion settings) and gives no sign of multi-step job pipelines, watched folders, or delivery steps. An API and CLI that a developer could script around are building blocks, not the capability itself.
